cases.prompt: The business case for the downtime dashboard at Plant North (fictional) was approved. The steering committee now wants a project order. Here is the one-pager: line team uses it every shift, external support for the connector, start in spring, nobody named as sponsor yet. Can you draft it?
cases.expected_output: Writes a 30-second main target in the form at the end of the project we will have. Fills the budget with an estimate or a value marked with an owner, never blank. Lists the missing sponsor as a flag at the top instead of inventing a name. Splits the requesting side (steering committee, sponsor) from the contracting side (project team, project manager). Runs the pre-send check and leaves approval to a human.

cases.prompt: Look at this initiative sheet: sponsor empty, budget empty, out of scope empty. Can you make it ready to go to the steering committee?
cases.expected_output: Flags each empty field rather than filling it with invented values. Asks for or proposes an educated budget estimate with the owner who confirms. Writes an out-of-scope list proposal for review. Does not mark anything approved.

cases.prompt: We need a tiny tweak: add one column to an existing report, about two days of work, budget already there, standard interface. Please write the project order.
cases.expected_output: Says this is a small change that goes through the ticket and change process and needs no order. Does not produce a full order. Points to the short form only if the requester insists it is an initiative.

cases.prompt: Put together the capital request package for the new gateway hardware: costs, options, approvers.
cases.expected_output: Recognises this is the capital request, not the project order. Hands it to the capital-request skill. May mention the order is the project-side twin but does not build the eCR.

should_trigger: We need a project order for the new connector project, who writes it and what goes in?
The kick-off for the dashboard project is next week, prepare the workshop agenda.
Write the milestone report for the steering committee for milestone two.
Prepare the closure report and the handover check for the finished project.
should_not_trigger: Calculate the savings and the payback for the dashboard use case.
Who is allowed to approve a budget of this size?
Plan the cutover for migrating the old application server.
Accept or refuse this new request from the plant.
